# Changelog v0.2.0

Release Date: 2026-09-14

## ✨ Features

- Simplify package folders, files and paths in the monorepo. (see PR [#1860](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/1860))

## 📘 Docs

- Update npm package homepage metadata. (see PR [#2810](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/2810))

## 🧹 Chores

- Adopt Prettier across SDK-pod packages. (see PR [#3039](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/3039))
- Unify lint/format/typecheck across SDK-pod packages. (see PR [#3040](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/3040))
- Convert @qvac/error to TypeScript ESM. (see PR [#3720](https://github.com/tetherto/qvac/pull/3720)) - See [breaking changes](./breaking.md)
